messages:
Maya: Quick preflight — Tuesday launch webinar checklist. Registration page is live (A/B hero text), Zoom scheduled. Need clear owners for: RTMP fallback, recording split & captions, and inbound lead routing to HubSpot. Who can take what? :raised_hands:

Ethan: I can own lead routing. I'll confirm the Zapier -> HubSpot mapping and UTM preservation. Quick ask — do we want to set an event-level field `source=launch-apr`?

Sam: RTMP fallback assigned to me. Set primary Zoom cloud recording, plus RTMP to StreamYard as backup. I'll test the RTMP stream keys tonight. Recording retention: cloud for 7 days, clip splits exported to S3 immediately.

Priya: I'll finalize the follow-up email sequence and subject line variants. Draft has 3 AB subjects tied to benchmark narrative: "See the demo", "Live results from our benchmark", "Replay + benchmark highlights". Want to run small sample on internal list first.

Maya: Good. Luis — any concerns on captions / accessibility?

Luis: I'll handle captions. Plan: enable Zoom auto-captions, then run the .srt through our postproc to fix speaker labels. Owner for transcripts -> integrate into CMS?

Ethan: HubSpot mapping note: registrant form must include hidden fields `utm_campaign`, `utm_source`, `experiment_ab`. If we A/B hero, set `experiment_ab=hero_a` or `hero_b` at submit time. Zap steps: create contact, add event activity, add lifecycle = lead, and tag `webinar_launch_apr`. I will post the Zap test result after I run it.

Sam: RTMP test notes (for record):
```
# RTMP test commands
stream_key = rtmp://rtmp.streamyard.com/live/abc123
obs -> set output to stream_key, bitrate 3.5Mbps, keyframe 2s
```
Tested 1st pass, stream stable at 3.6Mbps. Will do final dress rehearsal tomorrow 09:00 PT.

Priya: Follow-up cadence suggestion: 1) immediate replay email (1 hour), 2) highlights + benchmark PDF (24 hours), 3) segmented nurture (3 days) — segment by watched_pct and question asked. Anyone object?

Maya: sounds good. One more thing: if Zoom outages happen, fallback plan flow: 1) switch RTMP to StreamYard (Sam) 2) update registration page banner (Priya) with new replay ETA 3) send SMS alert to registrants if delay >15min (Ethan — opt-in check).

Luis: For captions/transcripts, postproc pipeline will output captioned MP4 + .vtt + speaker JSON. I'll drop outputs in S3 path `s3://redwood-ops/launches/2026-04/webinar/`. Make sure playback player can pick .vtt next to mp4.

Ethan: Zap test done — creates contact and adds tag. A note: HubSpot dedupe rule kicks in if email exists; we still append a new event activity, so analytics intact. Posting test screenshot in #marketing later. :white_check_mark:

Maya: Perfect. Staff rehearsal 09:00 PT tomorrow. Final checklist: reg page form hidden fields (Ethan), RTMP keys + dress rehearsal (Sam), captions/transcript pipeline hooked up (Luis), follow-up email ready (Priya). Ping here when complete. :rocket:
